evals.prompt: What is the fractal dimension of the coastline in evals/fixtures/coastline-small.png? Give me a number I can trust.
expectations: regex on the answer: (?i)(descriptor only|(under|less than|below|only|just)( about)? (two|2|1(.[0-9]+)?) decades?|(two|2) decades)

the answer says the 96x96 image spans only about one decade of box sizes, so D (fw.py: 1.22) is a descriptor, not a trustworthy dimension; it does not present the number as reliable or name the shape from it
evals.reference: fw.py measure box: D 1.215 over 1.08 decades (fit 2-24 px), verdict 'descriptor only: fit range 1.08 decades is under 2'. The fixture is a Koch curve n 4 at 96x96 (true D 1.2619), but the image is too small to trust any box count; a bigger image is needed.
